note: accord de résiliation de l'accord de fusion entre Amazon.com, Inc., Martin Merger Sub, Inc. et iRobot, effectif à la réception par iRobot de l'indemnité de résiliation
quote: This Termination Agreement (this "Agreement"), dated as of January 28, 2024, is by and between Amazon.com, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Parent"), Martin Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned Subsidiary of Amazon ("Merger Sub"), and iRobot Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the "Company" and, together with Parent and Merger Sub, the "Parties")
